data.one_liner: JSON parser that supports comments, trailing commas, and hexadecimal numbers
data.what_it_does: It parses JSON strings that contain comments and trailing commas, returning Dart objects. It also supports hexadecimal numeric literals.
use_when: Parsing configuration files that include comments
Debugging JSON data with inline comments
Working with legacy JSON that uses trailing commas
avoid_when: When strict JSON compliance is required
When performance or size is critical
strengths: Supports comments, trailing commas, and hex numbers
